Technology._sector_notes: Distinguish from Communication Services (media/telecom/ad-tech) and Industrials (industrial automation hardware). Avoid using bare words like 'platform', 'digital', 'innovation', 'solution' as signals — they appear everywhere and add no discriminating power.

Semiconductors.description: Design, manufacturing, and supply of microchips, CPUs, GPUs, memory, ASICs, foundries, and advanced process nodes.

Software.description: Development of operating systems, enterprise applications, SaaS, databases, developer tools, and cloud applications.

Hardware.description: Manufacturing of computers, servers, electronic devices, peripherals, storage systems, and technology infrastructure.

Networking Equipment.description: Communication infrastructure, routers, switches, networking systems, and data center connectivity hardware.
avoid_confusion_with: Cybersecurity (software/services, not the appliance hardware itself)

IT Services.description: Technology consulting, systems integration, infrastructure management, outsourcing, and digital transformation services.

Electronic Equipment.description: Electronic instruments, sensors, measurement systems, and specialized technology systems for industrial and lab use.
avoid_confusion_with: Life Sciences Tools (lab instruments for biotech)

Artificial Intelligence.description: Hardware and software for model training and inference, AI accelerators, machine learning, and generative AI applications.

Cloud Computing.description: IaaS, PaaS, SaaS infrastructure, cloud data centers, cloud storage, and distributed computing services.
avoid_confusion_with: Data Center REITs (real estate ownership, not the compute service)

Cybersecurity.description: Protection of networks, systems, applications, and data through threat detection, identity management, and access control.

Enterprise Technology.description: Enterprise applications, ERP, CRM, automation, productivity software, and digital business solutions.

Technology Components.description: Integrated circuits, electronic components, storage devices, connectors, circuit boards, and sensors used in tech products.

Market Catalysts.description: Sector-specific events that move technology stocks.
keywords: antitrust ruling against a tech company

Financial Metrics.description: Note: these overlap heavily with other sectors — use only in combination with sector-specific keywords above, never alone.

Financials._sector_notes: Distinguish from Real Estate (mortgage REITs) and Consumer Discretionary (retail credit cards issued by retailers). Avoid generic 'growth', 'earnings', 'guidance' as sole signals.

Banking.description: Commercial banks, regional banks, retail banking, corporate banking, deposits, mortgages, and consumer credit.

Investment Banking.description: M&A advisory, equity/debt underwriting, IPOs, leveraged finance, and securities issuance.

Capital Markets.description: Brokerage, securities trading, stock exchanges, market making, derivatives, and fixed income.

Asset Management.description: Mutual funds, ETFs, institutional asset management, wealth management, and alternative investments.

Consumer Finance.description: Credit cards, personal loans, auto finance, point-of-sale financing, and unsecured consumer credit.

Insurance.description: Property and casualty, life, health-related insurance, reinsurance, annuities, and underwriting.
avoid_confusion_with: Managed Care (health insurance, categorized under Health Care)

Mortgage Finance.description: Residential and commercial mortgages, mortgage servicing, refinancing, and mortgage-backed securities.

Diversified Financial Services.description: Financial conglomerates, specialty finance, fintech, and diversified financial products.

Payments.description: Credit card networks, debit cards, payment processing, digital payments, and merchant acquiring.

Operating Metrics.description: Financials-specific operating language distinct from generic 'earnings'.

Risk and Capital.description: Bank capital adequacy and risk terminology.

Communication Services._sector_notes: Distinguish from Technology (Software/Cloud) — Communication Services covers content, telecom carriage, and ad-supported platforms, not enterprise software. Distinguish 'Gaming' here (video games/publishers) from 'Leisure and Entertainment' casinos under Consumer Discretionary.

Telecommunications.description: Wireless and fixed-line telecom, mobile voice/data, broadband internet, and fiber networks.

Interactive Media.description: Search engines, social media platforms, digital communities, and internet-based communication services.

Entertainment.description: Film, television, music, streaming platforms, video games, and content production.

Media.description: Television networks, broadcasting, publishing, digital media, and news organizations.

Digital Advertising.description: Online advertising, search advertising, social media advertising, and programmatic ad platforms.
avoid_confusion_with: Interactive Media (platform itself vs. its ad revenue)

Cable and Broadband.description: High-speed internet, cable television, broadband infrastructure, and residential communications.

Wireless Services.description: Mobile voice/data subscriptions, 5G connectivity, and spectrum capacity.

Streaming.description: Subscription video-on-demand, ad-supported streaming, and subscriber-based media platforms.

Gaming.description: Console games, PC games, mobile games, game publishing, and in-game purchases.
avoid_confusion_with: Leisure and Entertainment (casinos, theme parks — Consumer Discretionary)

Content and Media Rights.description: Film/TV production, sports broadcasting rights, music rights, and content licensing.

Health Care._sector_notes: Distinguish from Consumer Staples 'Consumer Health' (OTC products sold via retail) and Materials 'Chemicals' (industrial chemistry vs. pharma chemistry).

Pharmaceuticals.description: Prescription drugs, branded medicines, generic drugs, vaccines, and pharmaceutical manufacturing.

Biotechnology.description: Biologic drugs, gene therapies, cell therapies, immunotherapies, and biotechnology research.

Medical Devices.description: Surgical instruments, implants, diagnostic equipment, cardiovascular devices, and orthopedic products.

Diagnostics.description: Diagnostic tests, laboratory testing, molecular diagnostics, and clinical laboratory services.

Managed Care.description: Health insurance, managed care organizations, Medicare, Medicaid, and reimbursement services.

Health Care Providers.description: Hospitals, clinics, physicians, outpatient facilities, and healthcare delivery.

Health Care Services.description: Healthcare distribution, pharmacy services, clinical research, and healthcare logistics.

Life Sciences Tools.description: Laboratory equipment, research instruments, reagents, and scientific research technologies.

Drug Development.description: Drug discovery, preclinical research, clinical trials, and regulatory submissions.

Medical Technology.description: Diagnostic platforms, imaging systems, robotic surgery, and connected medical equipment.

Industrials._sector_notes: Distinguish from Technology 'Automation and Robotics' (industrial robots here vs. software automation in Tech) and Materials (raw inputs vs. finished equipment).

Aerospace.description: Commercial aircraft, aircraft engines, aviation systems, and aircraft manufacturing.

Defense.description: Defense systems, military aircraft, missiles, radar, weapons platforms, and government contracts.

Industrial Machinery.description: Heavy machinery, industrial equipment, turbines, pumps, compressors, and production systems.

Construction Equipment.description: Excavators, bulldozers, cranes, loaders, and mining machinery.

Electrical Equipment.description: Electrical components, power systems, transformers, generators, motors, and industrial controls.

Building Products.description: Construction materials, HVAC equipment, electrical products, and architectural components.

Engineering and Construction.description: Engineering services, infrastructure development, civil engineering, and project management.

Transportation.description: Railroads, airlines, trucking, shipping, logistics, and fleet services.

Commercial Services.description: Business services, environmental services, staffing, facility management, and waste management.

Industrial Distribution.description: Distribution of industrial equipment, machinery, electrical components, and maintenance supplies.

Automation and Robotics.description: Industrial robots, factory automation, control systems, and automated production systems.

Consumer Discretionary._sector_notes: Distinguish from Consumer Staples (discretionary/non-essential purchases vs. necessities) and Communication Services 'Gaming' (video games vs. casinos here).

Automobiles.description: Passenger vehicles, electric vehicles, automotive components, dealerships, and vehicle financing.

Apparel and Footwear.description: Clothing, footwear, accessories, sportswear, and fashion brands.

Household Durables.description: Furniture, appliances, home electronics, and home furnishings.

Leisure and Entertainment.description: Theme parks, casinos, recreational products, entertainment venues, and cruises.

Hotels and Resorts.description: Hotels, resorts, lodging, vacation properties, and hospitality.
avoid_confusion_with: Hotel and Resort REITs (Real Estate, ownership vs. operation)

Restaurants.description: Quick-service restaurants, casual dining, fast-casual, and franchised restaurants.
avoid_confusion_with: Food Products (Consumer Staples, packaged food makers)

Retail.description: Specialty retail, department stores, home improvement, discount stores, and e-commerce.

Luxury Goods.description: Luxury apparel, accessories, watches, jewelry, and premium consumer products.

E-Commerce.description: Online marketplaces, digital retail platforms, and direct-to-consumer commerce.
keywords: online penetration rate of retail sales

Home Improvement.description: Building materials, tools, hardware, renovation products, and DIY products.

Consumer Staples._sector_notes: Distinguish from Consumer Discretionary (necessities vs. discretionary spend) and Health Care 'Consumer Health' vs. this sector's 'Consumer Health' subcategory — keep OTC wellness distinct from prescription pharma.

Beverages.description: Soft drinks, bottled water, alcoholic beverages, coffee, and packaged beverages.

Food Products.description: Packaged foods, snacks, dairy, frozen foods, cereals, and prepared foods.

Household Products.description: Household cleaners, detergents, paper products, and laundry products.

Personal Care.description: Cosmetics, skincare, haircare, toiletries, and oral care.
avoid_confusion_with: Luxury Goods (prestige beauty vs. mass beauty)

Tobacco.description: Cigarettes, cigars, smokeless tobacco, and nicotine products.

Food Retail.description: Supermarkets, grocery stores, discount grocers, and convenience stores.

Consumer Health.description: Over-the-counter healthcare products, vitamins, and non-prescription wellness products.

Pet Products.description: Pet food, pet care products, and animal health products.
avoid_confusion_with: Health Care Providers (human vs. animal health)

Packaged Consumer Goods.description: Branded packaged products, private-label products, and fast-moving consumer goods.

Energy._sector_notes: Distinguish from Utilities (regulated power delivery vs. commodity extraction/production) and Materials/Petrochemicals overlap.

Upstream Exploration and Production.description: Oil and gas exploration, drilling, crude oil and natural gas production, and reserves.

Integrated Oil and Gas.description: Integrated majors combining exploration, refining, marketing, and petrochemicals.

Midstream.description: Oil and gas pipelines, gathering systems, storage terminals, and energy logistics.
avoid_confusion_with: Natural Gas and LNG (production/export vs. transport)

Oilfield Services.description: Drilling services, well completion, hydraulic fracturing, and production support.
avoid_confusion_with: Energy Equipment (equipment maker vs. service provider)

Refining.description: Crude oil refining, gasoline, diesel, jet fuel, and refined fuel production.

Energy Marketing.description: Wholesale fuel distribution, petroleum marketing, fuel retailing, and commodity trading.

Natural Gas and LNG.description: Natural gas production, liquefaction, LNG exports, and regasification.

Petrochemicals.description: Chemical feedstocks, plastics, olefins, aromatics, and petroleum-derived chemical products.

Energy Equipment.description: Drilling rigs, pumps, compressors, valves, and specialized energy machinery.

Materials._sector_notes: Distinguish from Energy 'Petrochemicals' (feedstock chemistry) and Industrials 'Building Products' (finished construction products vs. raw materials here).

Chemicals.description: Commodity chemicals, specialty chemicals, industrial gases, coatings, and agricultural chemicals.

Metals and Mining.description: Mining and processing of copper, gold, silver, aluminum, iron ore, nickel, zinc, and lithium.

Steel.description: Steel production, flat-rolled steel, long steel products, and metal fabrication.
avoid_confusion_with: Metals and Mining (iron ore vs. finished steel)

Aluminum.description: Aluminum mining, alumina refining, smelting, and rolled products.

Precious Metals.description: Gold, silver, platinum-group metals, and bullion-related products.

Fertilizers.description: Nitrogen, phosphate, potash fertilizers, and agricultural chemicals.

Construction Materials.description: Cement, aggregates, concrete, asphalt, and infrastructure-related materials.

Packaging.description: Paper packaging, cardboard, containers, bottles, cans, and consumer packaging.
avoid_confusion_with: Forest Products and Paper (raw pulp vs. finished packaging)

Forest Products and Paper.description: Pulp, paper, tissue products, and wood products.

Utilities._sector_notes: Distinguish from Energy (regulated delivery/generation vs. commodity extraction) and Real Estate 'Data Center REITs' (power demand driver, not the utility itself).

Electric Utilities.description: Electricity generation, transmission, distribution, and regulated utility infrastructure.

Natural Gas Utilities.description: Natural gas distribution, transmission, storage, and regulated gas services.
avoid_confusion_with: Natural Gas and LNG (Energy sector, production/export)

Water Utilities.description: Water supply, wastewater treatment, and regulated water systems.

Multi-Utilities.description: Companies providing combinations of electricity, gas, water, and wastewater services.

Independent Power Producers.description: Merchant electricity generation, wholesale power markets, and power purchase agreements.

Renewable Energy.description: Solar, wind, hydroelectric generation, battery storage, and clean energy infrastructure.

Nuclear Power.description: Nuclear electricity generation, reactor operations, and long-term power contracts.

Grid Infrastructure.description: Transmission lines, distribution networks, smart grids, and grid reliability infrastructure.

Real Estate._sector_notes: Distinguish from Utilities (data center power vs. data center real estate) and Financials 'Mortgage Finance' (loan origination vs. property ownership).

Residential REITs.description: Apartment buildings, single-family rentals, manufactured housing, and student housing.

Office REITs.description: Office buildings, corporate properties, and commercial office leasing.

Retail REITs.description: Shopping centers, malls, and commercial retail real estate.

Industrial and Logistics REITs.description: Warehouses, distribution centers, and supply-chain real estate.

Data Center REITs.description: Data centers, colocation facilities, and digital infrastructure real estate ownership.
avoid_confusion_with: Cloud Computing (Technology, the compute service, not the building)

Hotel and Resort REITs.description: Hotels, resorts, and lodging properties held by REITs.
avoid_confusion_with: Hotels and Resorts (Consumer Discretionary, the operating brands)

Healthcare REITs.description: Hospitals, senior housing, skilled nursing, and medical office buildings held by REITs.

Self-Storage REITs.description: Self-storage facilities and rental storage properties.

Specialized REITs.description: Cell towers, timberland, casinos, labs, and other specialized real estate assets.
avoid_confusion_with: Telecommunications (tower tenants vs. tower REIT landlords)

Real Estate Development.description: Property development, land acquisition, and construction of residential/commercial projects.
avoid_confusion_with: Engineering and Construction (Industrials, the contractor vs. the developer/owner)

Property Management.description: Property operations, leasing, tenant management, and real estate administration.
